subject: Night window SLO coverage — temporary routing & escalation bridging plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@clearskyhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops SRE Team <sre-team@clearskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 03:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Night window — recent latency spikes and on-call coverage

Hi Connor,

We saw two P1-style incidents over the past weekend between 02:00-04:00 PT where token-level latency for our production endpoints spiked ~4-5x for ~18 minutes total. Our monitoring flagged them as P1 and PagerDuty routed to our on-call, but the rotation there missed Redwood's escalation path (calls went unanswered, SMS dropped). We escalated manually to your support email and eventually got a response from a support engineer, but the response time was outside our contractual P1 target.

We understand this is a low-traffic window for Redwood but ClearSky needs guaranteed overnight coverage for our mission-critical workflows. We're opening a formal request to: 1) get a temporary plan for guaranteed on-call coverage for the next 60 days while we finish our traffic rebalancing, 2) get a clear escalation path (who is paged at what step), and 3) have a short remediation runbook and routing diagram we can reference in audits.

Can you confirm next steps and an ETA on a bridging plan? We may need a one-time service credit if the outage meets P1 criteria under the SLO.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Ops, ClearSky Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 05:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night window SLO coverage — temporary routing & escalation bridging plan

Samir — thanks for the level-set and sorry for the friction this weekend. I appreciate the clear asks.

Short answer: we can provide a temporary bridging plan covering the next 60 days while ClearSky completes the rebalancing. I outlined a practical sequence below and attached a short runbook + routing diagram for your audit team.

Proposed temporary plan (summary):
- Hours covered: 00:00-06:00 PT (maintain until 2027-10-09)
- Coverage model: Redwood will assign 2x dedicated on-call engineers during the window (one primary, one backup) and enable immediate escalation to a remote engineering manager if an incident is classified P1
- Escalation matrix: PagerDuty -> SMS + phone call to primary on-call at T+0, if no ack by T+5 -> SMS + call to backup, if no ack by T+10 -> escalate to Red Ops manager (Marissa) and auto-create bridged Zoom link
- Service credit clause: we'll evaluate incidents against the SLO; if confirmed P1 response missed due to routing/failure on Redwood side we will apply a pro-rated credit (to be agreed in a short amendment)

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal assignment & confirmation (I will confirm named engineers + hours within 6 hours)
2) Joint incident run-through (tabletop) scheduled this week with ClearSky SREs and Redwood on-call
3) Sign short-term amendment for 60-day coverage and credit terms

I looped in Marissa (Head of Customer Reliability) to approve the escalation carveout and Laura (Enterprise Ops) for contractual language and tracking. Ben (Account Exec) — please add any commercial notes.

Attaching: night-coverage-runbook.pdf, slo-routing-diagram.png

Connor O'Brien
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 07:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night window SLO coverage — temporary routing & escalation bridging plan

Connor — thanks for drafting. A few operational clarifications before we confirm:

- I can approve the 60-day window but need confirmed names for primary/backup on-call and confirmation they will not be pulled into larger incident rotations during this period. Please provide names within 6 hours.
- We need a lightweight amendment: coverage dates, hours, escalation steps (the matrix you proposed), and a cap on total credit exposure (e.g., max X% of monthly invoice) — Laura, can you handle the amendment language?
- Runbook checklist: include exact PagerDuty policy ID, phone numbers for primary/backup, Zoom bridge template, and the SLA evaluation rubric (how we classify P1 vs P2 retrospectively).

Operational ask to Ben: please notify ClearSky's procurement that this will be processed as a short-term SOW amendment (no change to baseline committed capacity). Ben, can you coordinate and confirm acceptance by EOD?

I will stand up the temporary schedule in our on-call roster tool once names are confirmed. Also adding a 30-minute tabletop window Thursday 09:00 PT — Connor, Ben, please confirm.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clearskyhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Night window SLO coverage — temporary routing & escalation bridging plan

Samir — quick update and commitment:

1) Confirmed coverage: Primary = Diego Ramos (diego.ramos@redwood.com), Backup = Minah Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.com). Both have agreed to the 00:00-06:00 PT window and are designated 2nd-shift on-call for ClearSky for the next 60 days.
2) Escalation steps and PagerDuty policy ID included in attached runbook.
3) Proposed tabletop: Thu 12 Aug 2027, 09:00 PT. I sent a calendar invite — please accept or propose alternate times.
4) Ben is drafting the short amendment for the credit cap and coverage dates; Laura will review. Expect a draft to ClearSky legal within 24 hours.

We've attached the runbook and routing diagram (same as internal copy). Please reply if anything looks off; otherwise we'll treat this as agreed operationally and proceed with schedule changes.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Senior Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
